name: Agent Performance and Benchmarking
outcome: Run a reproducible coding-agent benchmark and interpret quality, variability and resource trade-offs.
description: Compare coding-agent configurations on representative scientific tasks. Control evaluation conditions, repeat runs and report uncertainty instead of relying on leaderboard rankings.
learn: Define a representative task set and deterministic success criteria
Run and record comparable experiments under a fixed budget
Interpret success rates, cost, latency and failure modes with appropriate caveats
tools: Claude Code CLI or Codex CLI (choose one)
prior: Basic statistics, Python and reproducible experiment design
practice: Compare two harness configurations on a small fixed set of scientific coding tasks; use a supplied runner and small run budget.
acceptance: The experiment records configuration, independent pass/fail results and repeats; conclusions distinguish observed results from general claims.
external: Basic statistics, Python and reproducible experiment design
moduleDescriptions: Choose tasks, baseline, success criteria and fixed resource budgets.
Record model, CLI, harness settings and task inputs; repeat small runs.
Compare outcomes, latency and available token counts; categorize failures.
Report variability, contamination risk and workload-specific conclusions.
prerequisiteRationale: S06 supplies controlled harness configurations and independent checks, allowing comparisons that isolate a meaningful variable.
